text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder!
Grass Wonder has finally achieved the Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah--!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: As expected of the "Second-Generation Monster"!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: You helped Maruzensky make one of her unfulfilled dreams come true, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Facing the unending cheers, Grass Wonder
said nothing, simply bowing deeply.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Lunch break, a few days later.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Do you have a moment
before training~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There was something I wanted to give you.
Um... it's nothing grand, though.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Think of it as a small token of my gratitude~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Achieving the Triple Crown
wasn't something I did by my own power alone."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"It's just that, given my position,
I inevitably draw more attention."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: At the very least, I wanted to properly let you know myself~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...We did it, we won the Triple Crown, didn't we?♪
Hehehe~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With those words, what was brought out was... three small victory sashes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...No, likewise.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Achieving the Triple Crown is the highest possible honor
in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: A dream that so many Umamusume yearn for with all their hearts, yet can never grasp.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It really does... make you straighten your posture, doesn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much
for making me a Triple Crown Umamusume.
choice_data_list: ...It's something you won through your own strength.
...It's something you won through your own strength.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No, I am... still far from ready.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's response
held an underlying, deeper meaning.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...It is nothing of great importance, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The defeated Umamusume wasn't the only one
whose dream of achieving the Triple Crown went unfulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There are many Umamusume who,
due to all sorts of circumstances, never even got the chance to run.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"If only she could have run."
The wall of the Umamusume spoken of in such terms is—formidable after all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why now,
even after attaining the highest peak of honor—"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I felt firsthand the sheer magnitude of what I have to overcome.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, so that's why. I want to stay on my toes and keep giving it my all from now on, too~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I will remain "unyielding" going forward.
I look forward to your continued support.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That searing blue flame was instantly tucked away behind Grass Wonder's gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Man,
I'm completely out of the loop.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Sei-chan.
What are you doing over there?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh, no no, never mind.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...More importantly,
wanna go hang out at the shopping district for a bit?
Let's go eat some taiyaki and dango!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wah, I want to go!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, but why all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm.
...Because I'm in the mood for stress eating.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The battle of the Classic Triple Crown ended quietly.
The Japan Cup was just around the corner.
